about: Womb with a View comic panels, from David Levine's panel script. Every line of dialogue and every caption is a slug: the dialogue is drawn in a text box OVER the picture, never inside the artwork, so a translation reaches it. No artwork exists yet; each frame carries its visual brief and shows a text placeholder until an illustrator draws it.

storyCards.imageDesc: The baby marks off a tiny calendar inside the womb with a pencil. Visits 1 to 8 carry happy star stickers. The baby is on the phone, pointing at the calendar.

frames.imageDesc: The baby marks off a tiny calendar inside the womb with a pencil. Visits 1 to 8 carry happy star stickers. The baby is on the phone, pointing at the calendar.
The baby stands beside a tiny pipe labelled 'Mommy's blood' and inspects the flow with a magnifying glass.
The baby wears tiny knight's armour. A glowing shield appears as a nurse outside gives Mommy an injection in the arm.
The baby in a tiny yellow hard hat holds a clipboard beside a stack of glowing MMS bricks.

storyCards.imageDesc: A frustrated mosquito has its stinger comically bent sideways against a glowing grid - the bed net - over Mom's bed. Doc image note: bend the mosquito's nose; can the baby be under the net?

frames.imageDesc: A frustrated mosquito has its stinger comically bent sideways against a glowing grid - the bed net - over Mom's bed. Doc image note: bend the mosquito's nose; can the baby be under the net?
The baby holds its nose and gestures with the phone at a no-smoke sign on the womb wall. Faint dark fumes try to seep in from outside and are blocked.
The baby is tossed about inside the womb, clinging to a tiny phone, motion blur all around. Outside, Mommy carries a very big jug of water.

The baby in a tiny general's hat points to a to-do list on the womb wall - wash dishes, fetch water, cook dinner - with a big tick beside a picture of Dad, not Mom. Doc image note: add the umbilical cord; the checklist is unclear, decide which items are ticked.

en.text: Womb with a view: at the clinic

rw-RW.text: Womb with a View: ku ivuriro

en.text: The baby checks the visits, the tests, the injection and the daily pill.

rw-RW.text: Umwana areba isura, ibipimo, urushinge n'ikinini cya buri munsi.

en.text: Another check-up, Mommy. Ask if I am growing properly. We already know I am adorable.

rw-RW.text: Irindi sura, Mama. Baza niba ndimo gukura neza. Ko tuzi ko ndi mwiza!

en.text: Go to all your antenatal visits - at least eight - so the nurse can check you and the baby.

rw-RW.text: Jya mu masura yose yo gusuzumisha inda - nibura umunani - kugira ngo umukozi w'ubuzima akurebe wowe n'umwana.

en.text: Everything I get comes through your blood, Mommy. Let the nurse check it is good!

rw-RW.text: Ibyo mpabwa byose binyura mu maraso yawe, Mama. Reka umukozi w'ubuzima arebe ko ameze neza!

en.text: Some infections and low blood have no signs. Get tested at your first visit.

rw-RW.text: Zimwe mu ndwara n'amaraso make ntibigaragaza ibimenyetso. Ipimishe ku isura ryawe rya mbere.

en.text: Tetanus? Not today. Mommy's injection is my shield.

rw-RW.text: Tetanosi? Si uyu munsi. Urushinge rwa Mama ni ingabo yanjye.

en.text: The tetanus injection is safe in pregnancy and protects you and the new baby. Bring your card and ask which doses you need.

rw-RW.text: Urushinge rwa tetanosi nta kibazo rutera ku batwite kandi rurinda wowe n'uruhinja. Zana ikarita yawe ubaze inshinge ukeneye.

en.text: Do you take the pill the nurse gave you every day, Mommy? These fine toes do not build themselves.

rw-RW.text: Ese ufata ikinini umukozi w'ubuzima yaguhaye buri munsi, Mama? Sinshobora kwiyubaka njyenyine.

en.text: Take one supplement pill every day. If it upsets your stomach, take it with the evening meal. Do not stop without asking the nurse.

rw-RW.text: Fata ikinini kimwe cy'inyongera buri munsi. Niba gitera kubabara mu nda, gifate ku mafunguro ya nimugoroba. Ntugahagarike utabajije umukozi w'ubuzima.

en.text: Womb with a view: keeping my room safe

rw-RW.text: Womb with a View: kurinda icyumba cyanjye

en.text: Bed nets, smoke, heavy loads, and who else can do the chores.

rw-RW.text: Inzitiramubu, umwotsi, imizigo iremereye, n'abandi bashobora gukora imirimo yo mu rugo.

en.text: Sorry, mosquito. This room is occupied. No visitors!

rw-RW.text: Mbabarira, mubu. Iki cyumba kirimo umuntu. Nta bashyitsi!

en.text: Sleep under a treated bed net every night.

rw-RW.text: Ryama mu nzitiramubu ifite umuti buri joro.

en.text: Cough, cough! Mommy, somebody is smoking. Tell them my room has a strict no-smoking rule!

rw-RW.text: Inkorora, inkorora! Mama, hari unywa itabi. Babwire ko mu cyumba cyanjye bibujijwe kunywa itabi!

en.text: Keep away from tobacco smoke, alcohol and cooking smoke.

rw-RW.text: Irinde umwotsi w'itabi, umwotsi wo guteka, n'inzoga.

en.text: Hello Daddy! Could you carry that? Mommy is already carrying me.

rw-RW.text: Muraho Papa! Ese wowe wagitwara? Mama asanzwe antwaye.

en.text: Rest, and let someone else lift the heavy things.

rw-RW.text: Ruhuka, kandi ureke undi muntu aterure ibiremereye.

en.text: Hi Daddy. Mommy is making a whole person. You can make dinner.

rw-RW.text: Muraho Papa. Mama ari gukora umuntu wuzuye. Wowe ushobora guteka ifunguro rya nimugoroba.

en.text: Ask your partner and family to take the heavy chores so you can rest.

rw-RW.text: Saba uwo mubana n'umuryango gukora imirimo iremereye kugira ngo uruhuke.

en.text: Womb with a view: one more plate

rw-RW.text: Womb with a View: indi sahani

en.text: The baby asks for one extra meal a day.

rw-RW.text: Umwana asaba irindi funguro rimwe ku munsi.

en.text: One plate for you, one more for me, Mommy!

rw-RW.text: Isahani imwe kuri wowe, indi kuri njye, Mama!

en.text: Eat one extra snack or small meal every day. Add eggs, fish, beans, greens and fruit.

rw-RW.text: Fata agafunguro kamwe cyangwa ifunguro rito ry'inyongera buri munsi. Ongeraho amagi, amafi, ibishyimbo, imboga n'imbuto.

en.text: Womb with a view: the warning siren

rw-RW.text: Womb with a View: impuruza

en.text: The baby sounds the alarm, and points at the pregnancy danger check.

rw-RW.text: Umwana avuza impuruza, akerekana aho wareba ibimenyetso by'akaga byo gutwita.

en.text: Mommy, heavy bleeding or a high fever means we go to the clinic now. I am much too young to handle emergencies!

rw-RW.text: Mama, kuva amaraso menshi cyangwa umuriro mwinshi bivuze ko tujya ku ivuriro nonaha. Ndi muto cyane ku byihutirwa!

en.text: Open the pregnancy danger check to see the signs that mean go to the clinic now.

rw-RW.text: Fungura isuzuma ry'ibimenyetso by'akaga byo gutwita urebe ibisobanura kujya ku ivuriro nonaha.

en.text: Womb with a view: ready for the day

rw-RW.text: Womb with a View: twiteguye umunsi

en.text: The birth kit, and the first golden milk.

rw-RW.text: Ibikoresho byo kubyara, n'amashereka ya mbere y'umuhondo.

en.text: Transport plan and money? Birth kit? Baby clothes? Good. I will bring myself.

rw-RW.text: Uburyo bwo kugenda n'amafaranga? Ibikoresho byo kubyara? Imyenda y'umwana? Byiza. Njye nzizana.

en.text: Open the birth plan to write down your transport, money and what to pack.

rw-RW.text: Fungura gahunda yo kubyara wandike uburyo bwo kugenda, amafaranga n'ibyo uzitwaza.

en.text: Just so you know, Mommy: within an hour of my arrival I want that first golden milk. Skip the honey - your milk is my favourite!

rw-RW.text: Umenye, Mama: mu isaha imwe mvutse nshaka amashereka ya mbere y'umuhondo. Reka ubuki - amashereka yawe ni yo nkunda!

en.text: Feed the baby your first yellow milk within an hour of birth. Give nothing else.

rw-RW.text: Onsa umwana amashereka yawe ya mbere y'umuhondo mu isaha ya mbere akimara kuvuka. Ntumuhe ikindi.

en.text: Womb with a view: moved out

rw-RW.text: Womb with a View: nimutse

en.text: Check-ups after the birth, both alarms, and waiting before the next pregnancy.

rw-RW.text: Isura nyuma yo kubyara, impuruza zombi, no gutegereza mbere yo kongera gutwita.

en.text: I have moved out! Now we both need check-ups, starting today.

rw-RW.text: Nimutse! Ubu twembi dukeneye kwisuzumisha, guhera uyu munsi.

en.text: Open the check-up reminders to put your visits in the app.

rw-RW.text: Fungura ibyibutsa by'isura ushyire amatariki yawe muri porogaramu.

en.text: Mommy, danger signs do not stop when I arrive. Heavy bleeding or fever means clinic now!

rw-RW.text: Mama, ibimenyetso by'akaga ntibihagarara nimara kuvuka. Kuva amaraso menshi cyangwa umuriro bivuze ivuriro nonaha!

en.text: Open the after-birth check to see the signs that mean go to the clinic now.

rw-RW.text: Fungura isuzuma ryo nyuma yo kubyara urebe ibimenyetso bisobanura kujya ku ivuriro nonaha.

en.text: If I am sick, take me to the clinic. I cannot dial yet!

rw-RW.text: Nindwara, unjyane ku ivuriro. Sinshobora guhamagara!

en.text: Open the newborn check to see the signs that mean go to the clinic now.

rw-RW.text: Fungura isuzuma ry'uruhinja urebe ibimenyetso bisobanura kujya ku ivuriro nonaha.

en.text: I have just moved out! This room needs two years of renovation before the next tenant.

rw-RW.text: Nimutse ubu! Iki cyumba gikeneye imyaka ibiri yo kuvugururwa mbere y'undi mwana.

en.text: Wait at least 2 years after a birth before the next pregnancy.

rw-RW.text: Tegereza nibura imyaka 2 nyuma yo kubyara mbere yo kongera gutwita.
